subject: Renewal: evidence & log-retention plan for upcoming recertification / capacity increase
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: John Park <john.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: evidence & log-retention plan for upcoming recertification / capacity increase

John —

Thanks for the quick renewal signal from your procurement team. Two things we want to align on before the renewal: 1) SOC re-certification evidence handoff and 2) the proposed capacity bump (additional 8 dedicated inference units) starting at renewal.

Quick asks to get us moving this week:
- Can you confirm the current SOC scope your security team requires (we currently provide SOC 2 Type II covering hosted API and Dedicated pools)?
- For audit evidence: will 90 days of raw access logs suffice, or do you need 12 months of queryable retention? We can provide 90 days via standard logs plus archived extracts on request; longer retention is a paid addon tied to retention storage.
- Please find attached a preliminary evidence checklist and our proposed RACI to speed the handoff.

Attachments: redwood_recert_checklist.xlsx, redwood-mpac-RACI.pdf

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute sync between your security lead and our security/solutions team. Rafael, Neha, Vivek — looping you in to coordinate the commercial/technical details.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0198
From: John Park <john.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Singh <aditi.singh@procure-acme.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence & log-retention plan for upcoming recertification / capacity increase

Tessa —

Thanks for the note and attachments. A few clarifications from our side:
- Scope: we need SOC 2 Type II covering API + Dedicated; we also want confirmation that Dedicated instances can be included in the same attestation (we believe so but please confirm).
- Retention: Our audit requires 12 months of retention for access logs. That said, we can accept an arrangement where 90 days are hot/online and the rest is archived in a tamper-evident store if the controls and access procedures meet our auditors' requirements.
- Evidence handoff: please provide a sampled extract of access logs (redacted IDs ok) and the most recent SOC 2 report for our vendor risk team.

Attaching a small export of the log format we expect: access_log_sample.csv

If we can get a concrete proposed timeline for the evidence and the commercial term addendum by EOD Friday that would help procurement.

—John
John Park
Sr. InfoSec Manager | Acme Analytics
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: John Park <john.park@acme-analytics.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence & log-retention plan for upcoming recertification / capacity increase

John — thanks for the clear asks. Commercial context to help your procurement team:
- Renewal effective date: 2027-05-15 (anniversary).
- Requested capacity increase: +8 dedicated inference units (monthly reserved). We can include a 60-day pro-rata credit for the change if the term addendum signs before the renewal effective date.
- Deal: D-2024-ACME-78 (HubSpot link below).

We’re open to the archive retention approach — Rafael speaking from the commercial side: longer-term retention will change MRR by ~6% depending on storage SLA. If your auditors require on-demand retrieval, we can commit to a playbook for retrieval windows.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890

Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Growth | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: John Park <john.park@acme-analytics.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence & log-retention plan for upcoming recertification / capacity increase

John / Aditi —

Thanks for the details. A few technical clarifications and a proposed timeline:
- Scope confirmation: Dedicated pools are part of the same control environment; we will include them in the SOC 2 package for the renewal period. I will mark the Dedicated cluster IDs in the evidence bundle.
- Logs: We can supply: 1) 90-day hot logs (full, queryable), 2) 12-month archived extracts (WORM copy) delivered as hashed CSVs + hash manifest for tamper evidence. Archive retrieval SLA: 5 business days by standard addendum or 48 hours for expedited + fee.
- Evidence deliverables: SOC 2 report (redacted where needed), control narratives, sample config snapshots, access_log_sample.csv (attached), and the evidence checklist. Please note PII fields will be redacted prior to handoff per our data minimization policy.

Proposed timeline:
- Apr 6: Gather and stage evidence bundle internally.
- Apr 9: Secure share to Acme via SFTP + manifest + signed hash.
- Apr 12: 30-minute review call to walk auditors through evidence.

Attachments: redwood_recert_checklist.xlsx, redwood-mpac-RACI.pdf

If that works, we’ll prepare the DocuSign term addendum for the retention and capacity changes (Neha/Marissa please coordinate pricing language).

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: John Park <john.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence & log-retention plan for upcoming recertification / capacity increase

Vivek / team —

Appreciate the clear timeline. That plan is acceptable to our auditors provided the archive manifests include hash verification and we have a retrieval SLA in writing. We also accept the hybrid retention (90 days hot + archived WORM for 12 months) — please include the retrieval SLA and any cost adders in the term addendum.

Procurement (cc'd) is ready to sign DocuSign once the term addendum references: 1) 12-month retention with archive retrieval SLA = 5 business days, 2) capacity change + pro-rata credit, 3) confirmation that Dedicated pools are in-scope for SOC.

Attaching signed acknowledgement for the evidence plan: DocuSign_Term_Addendum.pdf (procurement will countersign).

Regards,
John Park
Sr. InfoSec Manager | Acme Analytics
